ElRobot2-S2-RC2 – neck-grip (collar jaw) Z-lift SCARA

Design release candidate, not built. Arm and Z module are the S1 CAD; the hand, rack bench and bottles are S2 models. Purchased parts (column, rail, screw, motor, camera) are approximate boxes. The J3 chain is drawn with the S2 metal kit (machined shaft and flange, aluminium horn plate). Bench and tote are stand-ins that match the simulation, not the final printed rack.

MuJoCo replay (logged simulation)

Logged MuJoCo episodes of the S2-RC2 stand-in bench with the final Hand-track meshes (type C collar jaws unless marked F). Release = lower 2.0 mm, then open to 49 mm, then retreat. Rigid bodies; nominal bottle (cap 30.5, ring 33 x 2, neck 25.5, free neck 6 mm). The last two entries are Monte Carlo failures kept on purpose: a type C bottle that strikes a divider nose after a 3.7 mm lateral miss, and a type F bottle dragged out of the lane.
